name: What types of toilets are best for a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What types of toilets are best for a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' toilet depends on your needs and bathroom design. Popular options include one-piece toilets for easier cleaning, two-piece toilets for cost-effectiveness, wall-mounted toilets for a modern look and space-saving, and comfort-height toilets for accessibility. Water-efficient models (e.g., WaterSense certified) can also reduce water consumption. Our plumbers can discuss these options and help you select a suitable toilet that fits your remodel budget and aesthetic in areas like Avondale and Surprise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider one-piece, two-piece, wall-mounted, or comfort-height toilets. Water-efficient models are also a good choice.
